The 7.5-fold latency difference is highlighted. ROLLBACK appears at 17.4 seconds and a signal returns to the router; the share bar moves back to the control from 18 seconds.
New requests use the control. The candidate receives zero percent, and its failed latency result remains visible. The stage fades from 24 seconds, retaining the title for the loop.
